test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

These girls speak English fluently.

options.text: English is spoken fluently by these girls.
English was spoken fluently by these girls.
English has been spoken fluently by these girls.
English is being spoken fluently by these girls.

solution:
The correct answer is '**English is spoken fluently by these girls**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in active voice. As per the question we have to change it into passive voice.
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + infinitive + Object (Active voice)
 
• Subject (objective case) + to be + past participle + Object (subjective case) (Passive voice)
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *The grocer sells fresh vegetables. (Active voice)*
 
• *Fresh vegetables are sold by the grocer. (Passive voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is ‘these girls’.
 
• The object of the given sentence is ‘English’.
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• speak will be changed to is spoken.
 
• Correct sentence - English is spoken fluently by these girls.
